about: Rule 6 (research/ip.md, BAR_F G4, two scales as amended by Luis on 2026-11-18) on every figure the pod can write with the inkfig version it draws: every ring and every concept alone of the three gate species, 170 figures, each against the film's 38 logograms on the marks layer, best rotation and mirror. Coarse grid: the nearest film logogram's score; fine grid (1440 angles by 192 radii): a figure fails at or above the film's own floor for two logograms that share a drawn part (0.786). Numbers and the nearest logogram's file name only; no film image is committed. Read by tests/inked.test.mjs before the inked script may be on.

review.decision: publish the inked script with the figures as drawn by inkfig-0.6.1
review.hisWords: Let's incorporate them as we have them right now, please. Because if not, we're not going to progress.
review.sheet: Every figure at 0.65 or above on the coarse grid (123), each beside its nearest film logogram, was sent to his own device on 2026-11-18 before this decision; the sheet is not committed (film images stay off the site).
review.whatItIs: His decision to publish, given with the sheet in hand. It is not a pair-by-pair verdict: he named no pair as a copy and cleared none one by one. The fine grid, which fails a copy of a drawn part, passes every figure on its own (max 0.69 against 0.786).
